importPage.title: Bring your data across
importPage.subtitle: Import from another browser so you start where you left off.
importPage.description: Derp can copy your saved passwords, bookmarks, history and cookies from Vivaldi, Chrome, Edge, Safari and other browsers you have installed.

bookmarks.label: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: The whole tree, folders and all

history.label: History
history.description: So the address bar knows your habits

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.description: Stay signed in where you already were

importPage.opened: The import window is open — finish there, then come back.
importPage.passwordNote: Importing passwords asks your operating system for permission to unlock the other browser’s password store. That prompt comes from macOS or Windows, not from Derp.
importPage.skipNote: You can skip this and import later from the menu at any time.
importPage.looking: Looking for browsers you already use…
importPage.noneFound: No other browsers with data to import were found on this computer.
importPage.failed: That import did not finish. Nothing was changed.

hubPage.title: About Derp Hub
hubPage.subtitle: A central place for Derp-specific settings.
hubPage.description: Derp Hub is a dedicated settings center for Derp-specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:hub'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.
hubPage.tip: Tip: You can also access Derp Hub from the Firefox settings sidebar.

features.accessible: Accessible from about:hub or Firefox settings
features.centralized: All Derp-specific options in one place

customize.title: Customize Derp
customize.description: Customize to your preferred settings. You can always change them later from the Derp Hub or settings page.

appearance.title: Appearance Settings
appearance.description: You can customize Derp's appearance to your preference. Choose a light or dark theme, or have it automatically switch based on your system settings.

floorpHub.title: Derp Hub
floorpHub.description: Derp Hub is a dedicated settings center for Derp-specific options. You can open it by navigating to 'about:hub'. It can also be accessed from the left sidebar of Firefox's settings page at 'about:preferences'.

finish.title: Setup Complete!
finish.subtitle: Congratulations! You've completed the Derp setup. Enjoy a comfortable and secure internet browsing experience.
finish.hint: For more detailed settings, you can customize via the Settings option in the menu button at the top right.

welcomePage.description: Derp is a fast and user-friendly web browser that emphasizes privacy and security. This guide will introduce you to the main features and settings of Derp.
welcomePage.readyToStart: When you're ready, click the below button to proceed.

localizationPage.title: Derp speaks your language
localizationPage.subtitle: Check language settings and change if needed
localizationPage.chooseLanguage: Choose from a wide range of languages
localizationPage.languageChangeNotice: Changing language will apply the new language without restarting Derp. Some add-ons may not support language changes.

featuresPage.title: Main Derp Features
featuresPage.subtitle: Derp comes with many useful features. Check out the feature overview!

panelSidebar.title: Panel Sidebar
panelSidebar.description: Access convenient features from the sidebar on the right while browsing. You can place web panels, note-taking functions, add-ons, bookmarks, etc. in the sidebar.
features: Quickly take notes with Derp Notes while browsing

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Organize multiple tab sets to streamline your work. Quickly switch between workspaces with distinctive icons and names. Access via the workspace button in the top left.
features: Categorize by purpose: work, personal, etc.

pwa.title: Progressive Web Applications Support
pwa.description: On Windows, you can add PWA-compatible sites as desktop applications when you visit them. Regular websites can also be installed.
features: Can be pinned to the taskbar

mouseGesture.title: Mouse Gestures
mouseGesture.description: Control your browser more intuitively with natively implemented mouse gesture functionality. Execute gestures by holding the right-click button and moving your mouse.

finishPage.title: Setup Complete!
finishPage.subtitle: Congratulations! You've completed the Derp setup. You can now enjoy comfortable and secure internet browsing.
finishPage.hint: For more detailed settings, you can customize via the Settings option in the menu button at the top right.
finishPage.defaultBrowserSuccess: Derp has been set as your default browser!

whatsNew.title: Welcome to Derp {{version}}!
whatsNew.subtitle: Check out what's new in Derp!
